scientific_name: Tangent plane to normalized celestial unit vector
common_name: Tangent plane to normalized celestial unit vector
scientific_use: Reconstruct celestial Cartesian sky directions from bounded east/north gnomonic plane coordinates and an explicit tangent point.
scientific_purpose: Reconstruct celestial Cartesian sky directions from bounded east/north gnomonic plane coordinates and an explicit tangent point.

source_references.title: ERFA inverse celestial tangent-plane equations and conventions
Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: center=(cosd*cosa,cosd*sina,sind);east=(-sina,cosa,0);north=(-sind*cosa,-sind*sina,cosd);u=center+xi*east+eta*north;r=sqrt(dot(u,u));v=u/r;ordered RN32 graph and frozen turn trig.
input_contract: N1..4096 plane coordinates(xi,eta) in[-16,16],one tangent point ra[0,1),dec[-1/4,1/4] turns;finite binary32-hex,explicit GNOMONIC_TAN/EAST_NORTH/common frame;exact payload fields.
output_contract: N x4 binary32[vx,vy,vz,r];r is canonical unnormalized-vector norm;dimensionless sky direction and norm,complete zero-bit validation;no output RA/Dec or pixel WCS.
result_contract: N x4 binary32[vx,vy,vz,r];r is canonical unnormalized-vector norm;dimensionless sky direction and norm,complete zero-bit validation;no output RA/Dec or pixel WCS.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.

partition_strategy: complete independent plane-coordinate rows with shared tangent point
